caption: The drawing depicts a single tankard with a pewter lid and a handle. The tankard itself is cylindrical and appears to be made of a tan or light brown material with metallic qualities. The lid is circular and gray, with a thumb lever attached to the handle for opening. Three horizontal blue bands encircle the body of the tankard, spaced evenly between sections of raised ridges. The handle is attached vertically to the right side of the tankard, and the lever mechanism is mounted atop the handle. The background is plain and a light beige or off-white color, with no additional objects or decorative elements present.
title: Stoneware and Pewter Beer Mug
